subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should this broad report remain as an umbrella tracker, be narrowed in place to the unique CLI/TUI default-session behavior, or be closed only after every remaining behavior is explicitly routed to a canonical issue?
rationale: Current main still leaves behavior unresolved, but narrower open issues now own several parts of the root cause; automation should not choose the maintainer tracking and product boundary across core sessions, external WeChat, WebChat projection, and background-event isolation.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella Temporarily
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers confirm each remaining behavior has a canonical owner and no unique CLI/TUI evidence is lost.

options.title: Narrow In Place
options.body: Retitle and scope this issue to the CLI/TUI default-session behavior, then route the other pieces to existing narrower trackers.

options.title: Close After Routing
options.body: Close this issue after maintainers explicitly link the narrower canonical issues for CLI routing, sessions_send channel routing, WeChat delivery, activity ordering, and Gateway load/deadlock.

recommendation.title: Keep As Umbrella Temporarily
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers confirm each remaining behavior has a canonical owner and no unique CLI/TUI evidence is lost.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available routing owner from the related session-routing history and timeline signal, while specific WeChat/plugin questions may need additional owner review.
